text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Arab states should benefit more from unified economic policies with rest of world in developing their human resources, information minister says.
- Three-member government delegation leaves Bahrain on seven-day visit to Taiwan to discuss business opportunities.
- Bahraini firm Abdulla Ahmed Nass Contracting signsa contract to build golf course in Bahrain.
- Bahrain-based Gulf International Bank (GIB) signs $200 million debut floating rate note issued in international markets.
- Security forces arrest group of saboteurs who set cold store ablaze in Sitra area on Saturday.
- Bahrain's new frigate Sabha scheduled to arrive in the island on Wednesday.
